Each theme in this collection is a Quarto format extension. Install the collection once, then choose a theme for a project by naming its format.

```bash
quarto add brenobeirigo/quarto-themes
```

```yaml
format:
  lucid-html: default
```

## How a theme is built

A theme lives in `_extensions/brenobeirigo/<name>/` and declares one HTML format. Its SCSS layers set Bootstrap variables and publish colour tokens as CSS custom properties. Component stylesheets read only those tokens, so light and dark modes need no duplicated rules. A Lua filter adds build-time accessibility fixes and loads optional browser enhancements.

The [repository README](https://github.com/brenobeirigo/quarto-themes#readme) explains how to customise a theme and how to add a new one.
